Name: Custom Farm Loader
Author: DeLiXxN
Description:
[size=4][b]For Players
[/b][/size]- - - - - - - - - - - - -
This mod may be required by some custom farms to function properly, but you might want to download it anyhow for the farm related aesthetics such as a new gamepad friendly farm selection menu for custom farm types and farm type icons and names in the loading menu.


[size=3][b]Setup[/b][/size][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Unpack Custom Farm Loader in your Mods Folder
[*]Unpack your chosen [CFL] Farms in your Mods Folder
[*]Start the game using the SMAPI Launcher
[*]Upon creating a new game press the new Custom Button [img]https://gitlab.com/delixx/stardew-valley-custom-farm-loader/-/raw/main/Custom%20Farm%20Loader/Assets/CustomFarmIcon.png[/img]﻿﻿ and select your map
[/list][b][size=3]Multiplayer[/size][/b]

All Players need to have both Custom Farm Loader and the Farm you're intending to play on installed.
Mismatching versions will cause issues. It is recommended to keep your mods updated to the latest version.

[size=4][b]For Content Creators[/b]
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

[/size]Please refer to the gitlab readme for guides and documentation:
[url=https://gitlab.com/delixx/stardew-valley/custom-farm-loader]https://gitlab.com/delixx/stardew-valley/custom-farm-loader

[/url][b][size=4][color=#cc0000]( ! )[/color] [/size][size=3]1.6 Migration Notes (Updated 20.03)[/size][/b]
[url=https://gitlab.com/delixx/stardew-valley/custom-farm-loader/-/wikis/1.6-Migration-Notes]https://gitlab.com/delixx/stardew-valley/custom-farm-loader/-/wikis/1.6-Migration-Notes[/url]

[b]Why use Custom Farm Loader in 1.6?[/b]

Custom Farm Loader makes farm creation easy and is a great way to get into making your own custom farm.
It offers a lot of extensive functionality to bring life and joy into your abode.
The mods goal is to remove a lot of the bloat that comes from having to find custom farm creation related guides in a dozen different places and general purpose mods. Let's focus on what is important: Creating the farm of your dreams for people to enjoy.

[list]
[*]Improved UI
[*]Context based configuration reduces mistake potential and makes user modifications a lot easier
[*]Engaging Documentation
[*]Handy debug commands
[*]Use any of the vanilla map overlays without having to worry about recolors
[*]Extended and simplified StartFurniture placement
[*]Ability to place StartBuildings and Fence objects
[*]Extended functionality and variety for resource spawns
[*]Simplified and extended fishing functionality
[*]CP conditions supported
[*]History of fixing farm related vanilla bugs
[/list]
